title: Strategic Management
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the set of values, norms and standards that control how employees work to achieve an organisation's mission and goals."
The organisational culture is the set of values, norms and standards that control how employees work to achieve an organisation's mission and goals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the surroundings of business activities."
Business environment means the surroundings of business activities.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the set of decisions and actions taken in formulation and implementation of strategies designed to achieve objectives of an organisation."
Strategic management is defined as the set of decisions and actions taken in formulation and implementation of strategies designed to achieve objectives of an organisation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the art of using organisational resources to render the goals defined by the organisation with minimum risk."
Corporate strategy is the art of using organisational resources to render the goals defined by the organisation with minimum risk.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a cost reducing turnaround strategy."
Personnel retrenchment strategy is a cost reducing turnaround strategy.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the factor that links strategic management to the organisation's resources, including finances, facilities and equipment, land, access to information, goodwill and personnel."
Resource management is the factor that links strategic management to the organisation's resources, including finances, facilities and equipment, land, access to information, goodwill and personnel.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only means by which organisational resources can be allocated."
Budget is the only means by which organisational resources can be allocated.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a quantitative approximation of effective demand."
Market sales potential is a quantitative approximation of effective demand.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a relatively new mathematical technique in situations requiring optimum allocation of resources, money, capital equipment, raw materials and personnel."
Linear programming is a relatively new mathematical technique in situations requiring optimum allocation of resources, money, capital equipment, raw materials and personnel.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means "wait and see", indicating that the company should adopt hold/maintenance/preservation strategies aimed at stability and consolidation."
The yellow signal means "wait and see", indicating that the company should adopt hold/maintenance/preservation strategies aimed at stability and consolidation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of determining appropriate courses of action for achieving organisational objectives and thereby accomplishes the purpose."
Strategy formulation is the process of determining appropriate courses of action for achieving organisational objectives and thereby accomplishes the purpose.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fourth component of the common thread/strategy that measures the firm's ability to make good on a new product market entries."
Synergy is the fourth component of the common thread/strategy that measures the firm's ability to make good on a new product market entries.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the key link between strategic management and an organisation's external environment."
Strategic planning is the key link between strategic management and an organisation's external environment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the level of sales a single organisation expects to achieve based on a chosen marketing strategy and an assumed competitive environment."
A sales forecast is the level of sales a single organisation expects to achieve based on a chosen marketing strategy and an assumed competitive environment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a technique that considers the firm's strategic position in tandem with the industry's strategic position."
SPACE is a technique that considers the firm's strategic position in tandem with the industry's strategic position.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a systematic process of determining goals to be achieved in the foreseeable future."
Strategic management planning is a systematic process of determining goals to be achieved in the foreseeable future.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the strategic plan which discusses how the strategies will operate, states the conditions required and also states the contingency strategies associated with the chosen strategies."

A strategic blueprint is the strategic plan which discusses how the strategies will operate, states the conditions required and also states the contingency strategies associated with the chosen strategies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the analytical point of departure between CPM and PERT."
Duration is the analytical point of departure between CPM and PERT.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an acronym for Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities and Threats."
SWOT is an acronym for Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities and Threats.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the sales of a firm, product, or brand divided by the sales of the "market"."
Market share can be defined as the sales of a firm, product, or brand divided by the sales of the "market".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the vehicle for the deployment of resources."
Organisational structure is the vehicle for the deployment of resources.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a brief written description of the purpose of the organisation, and why a company is in operation."
A mission statement is a brief written description of the purpose of the organisation, and why a company is in operation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a simple step that is not simple."
Strategic choice is a simple step that is not simple.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the selection of alternative course of action from available alternatives in order to achieve a given objective."
A decision is the selection of alternative course of action from available alternatives in order to achieve a given objective.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those made at the business level."
Bridging corporate and functional-level decisions are those made at the business level.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the desire to shape and influence the behaviour of a person in a face-to-face interaction in the pursuit of company's goals."
Personal control - is the desire to shape and influence the behaviour of a person in a face-to-face interaction in the pursuit of company's goals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a structure with two (or more) channels of command, two lines of budget authority and two sources of performance and reward."
A matrix organisation is a structure with two (or more) channels of command, two lines of budget authority and two sources of performance and reward.

construct scope

Strategic management control and evaluation

______ is the everyday preoccupation of management in all types of organisations, whether small enterprises or multi-national corporations.
necessity to decide

______ is one of the highly sought after talents in management.
Creativity
Creativity is one of the highly sought after talents in management.

Strategy implementation in single industry

Strategic analysis

programme

______ is the fourth element of a corporate plan; other elements according to their hierarchy include- purpose/mission, objectives, strategy, procedures, rules, programmes and budgets.
Policy

______ is a desired future state, or objective that a company attempts to realise.
goal

______ is the second step in creative thinking.
Investigation

______ is defined as any part of business organisation which is treated separately for strategic management purposes (Sharplin, 1985).
Strategic business unit (SBU)
Strategic business unit
SBU

______ is a major source of power in companies.
CEO

______ can be defined as a comprehensive general approach that guides major actions toward the realisation of long-term objectives.
grand strategy

______ is a road map or guide by which an organisation moves from its current state of affairs to future desired state.
Strategy

______ is a manual or mechanical ways by which each operation is performed e.g. vacation procedures, exam procedures.
method

Divestment

______ is a transient but terminable chain of activities, events and duration designed to capture specified objectives on current basis only.

______ is a strategic planning method used to evaluate the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats involved in a project or in a business venture.
SWOT analysis

______ is one of the most crucial activities of management.
Decision-making

______ is an intellectual activity that is devoid of shrewd corporate manoeuvering or connivance.
Formulation

system
